The '''Blue Swirl''' was a region of the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] dominated by relatively calm activity and possessing a few lifeless planetoids. Nearby the Blue Swirl resided the [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]] of the [[Horns of Waryl]], a trio of stars that formed an inverse pyramid when viewed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yvara]].
